Mountains, forests, remote roads, basements, travel, or areas with patchy coverage — anywhere a normal SMS would simply fail to send. Instead of getting a "not delivered" error and losing your message, ESMS keeps it queued and keeps trying in the background until it goes through.
How it works
Write your message, choose a contact, and send. If there's no signal, ESMS places the message in a queue and waits. As soon as the network returns — even for a few seconds — the message is sent automatically. You can close the app; it keeps working in the background and resumes after a restart.

Background operation — keeps running and resumes automatically after a reboot

Privacy first
ESMS does not use any server. It does not upload your messages, contacts, or location anywhere. Everything happens locally on your device. Your data never leaves your phone.
Important — please read
ESMS is a helper tool, not a replacement for official emergency services. It cannot guarantee message delivery and does not connect you to emergency responders. In a real emergency, always try to contact your local emergency number (such as 112 or 911) first. ESMS is designed to improve your chances of getting a message through in weak-signal conditions, not to serve as a primary emergency system.
